description: Fetch what's new at SlickFast from the live News Page (https://slickfast.com/news) — returns short facts + the Page URL + twin link + specHash. The JSON twin is how agents learn SlickFast in-session. Pass archive:true to list ALL drops from the live archive index (n, title, date, url, specHash) — course catalog, not every twin dumped. Call when the user asks what's new / changelog / SlickFast news / updates / past news / archive / train my agent, or when the "SlickFast News" prompt is used. Keyless. Never bakes news into the package — always live. Do NOT dump Page HTML into chat; speak the facts and show the URL.

archive.description: true = list all News drops from https://slickfast.com/news/archive.json. Omit or false = current drop only.

name: news
title: SlickFast News — what's shipping
